name: Tongs
overview: Scripture references to tongs emphasize their role as sacred utensils associated with the worship of God, crafted from pure gold to signify holiness and reverence. In Exodus 25:38 and 1 Kings 7:49, tongs are mentioned alongside candlesticks and snuffdishes, highlighting their use in the careful handling of the temple's sacred lamps. Numbers 4:9 further illustrates the care taken in maintaining these items, as the tongs and related vessels were covered and protected during service, underscoring the importance of purity and order in the tabernacle worship.
